title: Device detail
summary: Everything Bipe knows about one device of the account, and, for an assistant or a bridge, what it reads and where its data goes (ADR 0291).

linkedAt.description: From the device entry, for bipe_device_detail_linked_at.

linkedBy.description: The name of the approving device's row, for bipe_device_detail_linked_by.

assistantSend.description: Only for kind assistant: the switch chat.bipe.assistant_send (ADR 0210), the same value as the row assistantSend of the group's section assistants.

fullContentRooms.description: Only for kind assistant: the chats where it reads every member (the chat.bipe.assistant room state, ADR 0130).

copyId.effect: Copies the device ID and shows bipe_device_detail_id_copied.

toggleAssistantSend.effect: Writes chat.bipe.assistant_send, as the switch in Privacidade does today.

signOut.effect: The same flow as askSignOut on linked-devices. Hidden for this device and on read-only platforms.

notes: The device ID shows only here and on the long press on the version (ADR 0291).
A bridge's detail says that Beeper sees room names, members and timing outside Brazil (ADR 0128).
